g.text: Request Workflow — Choreography with Persistent Waiting
commit request + run + READY cursor + trace
execute one shared step from persisted state
database cursor and work item are authoritative.
continue shared steps to waiting or terminal
commit each step before next event
EventBus is a transient trigger, not a durable queue or state store.
No Kafka, broker fallback, global run handler, or waiting subscriber.
Automated acceptance exercises the same sequence.
